# Issue drafts — NOT FILED

Three `good first issue` candidates, written but deliberately not opened. Nobody
has been contacted and no issue exists on GitHub.

To file one: open a new issue, paste the body of the file, use the file's `Title:`
line as the issue title, and add the labels on its `Labels:` line. Create the
labels first if the repo has none yet (`good first issue`, `help wanted`,
`adapter`, `documentation`).

| File | Scope | Why it is a good first issue |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `01-openai-judge-adapter.md` | One new file, one test | Clear spec, an existing adapter to copy, no design decisions |
| `02-trulens-deepeval-adapters.md` | Two thin wrappers | Mechanical; the hard part is already solved upstream |
| `03-audit-cli.md` | Small `argparse` entry point | Self-contained, stdlib only, visibly useful |

Ordered by how self-contained they are. `01` is the one to point a first-time
contributor at.
